unsafe base.
Cell a = Type (Cell a).
produce n = if n < 0 then produce (0 - n) else Cell (Cell n).
loop n a = if n <= 0 then a else (case produce n of Cell inner -> case inner of Cell x -> loop (n - 1) (a + x)).
main = print (loop 1000 0).

produce n = if n < 0 then produce (0 - n) else ((n,n + 1),(n + 2,n + 3)).
loop n a = if n <= 0 then a else (case produce n of (left,right) -> case left of (w,x) -> case right of (y,z) -> loop (n - 1) (a + w + x + y + z)).
main = print (loop 1000 0).
